capability: Raw HTTP header-pair validation with exact framing/authority/version, constant-time run-token comparison, reviewed beta combinations and credential-free upstream header projection.
limitations: No socket or request forwarding; test framing and run credentials are injected around actual SDK-captured headers.
Frozen beta semantics and live model/pricing/approval still require review; token spelling alone proves no billing property.
Run lookup, expiry/revocation, body/quote admission, HTTP server parsing, upstream isolation, provider key injection and response accounting remain integration work.
Body and header evidence are not yet jointly bound into a complete durable transport admission record.
